help.title: Writer help
help.description: Syntax, components and options of the slide engine.
help.activeParser: Active splitting: {active} (frontmatter {other} for the other mode).
help.completionTriggers: The autocompletion triggers on {components}, {annotations} and in the frontmatter.

structure.headingVertical: ### Title: vertical slide (stacked under the previous one)
structure.headingBreak: ---: new horizontal slide without a title
structure.separatorVertical: ----: vertical slide (stacked under the previous one)

components.quote: Quote with optional author, role and avatar
components.columns: Side-by-side columns (::column, span for the widths)
components.image: Image with framing (fit, position, rounded, shadow)
components.previewLink: Link with a preview of the target
components.screens: Gallery of Storybook screens (cols, gap, align)
components.storyFrame: Live Storybook screen (story, ratio, previewWidth, lightbox)

annotations.layout: Layout of the slide (media-right, grid-compact, full…)
annotations.pretitle: Text above the title (common thread, context)
annotations.subtitle: Text below the title (section subtitle)
annotations.slideBackground: Background image specific to this slide
annotations.quicklink: Navigation link pinned to the bottom of the slide

mediaText.label: Media + text
mediaText.description: Text on the left, image on the right (media-right layout)

fullScreenImage.label: Full-screen image
fullScreenImage.description: Image that fills the whole slide

storybookGallery.label: Storybook gallery
storybookGallery.description: Title + two Storybook screens side by side

root.title: Title of the presentation
root.lang: Language of the document; French typography applies in fr
root.project: Catalog folder (also set in Sharing and settings)
root.status: Visibility (Sharing and settings takes over once the presentation is published)
root.unlisted: Reachable by link but absent from the catalog
root.storybook: Address of the deployed Storybook, for the ::StoryFrame
root.code: Colors and font size of the code blocks: a theme (nuit, sombre, clair) or its settings
root.accessPassword: Password of the semi-private status (better set in Sharing and settings)

backgrounds.h1: Background of the slides opened by a # heading
backgrounds.h2: Background of the slides opened by a ## heading
backgrounds.h3: Background of the slides opened by a ### heading

code.theme: Starting code theme, which the other settings modify
code.border: Border of the code blocks (CSS border property)
code.size: Minimum code font size, in slide pixels (960 × 700)
code.dim: Opacity of the lines outside the active area of a JsonTour
code.activeBackground: Background of the active area of a JsonTour
code.activeBar: Bar of the active area of a JsonTour

reveal.width: Reference width of a slide, in pixels
reveal.height: Reference height of a slide, in pixels
reveal.margin: Margin around the slide, as a fraction of its size
reveal.slideNumber: Slide number: c/t (current/total), h.v, c, or false
reveal.fragments: Shows fragments one at a time
reveal.fragmentInURL: Writes the current fragment into the address
reveal.loop: Returns to the first slide after the last one
reveal.navigationMode: Keyboard navigation: default, linear or grid
reveal.showNotes: Shows the speaker notes to everyone
reveal.pdfMaxPagesPerSlide: Maximum pages per slide in the PDF export
reveal.pdfSeparateFragments: One page per fragment in the PDF export

shortcuts.formatJson: Format the JSON block under the cursor (otherwise all of them)
